question: NSAIDs for Discogenic lower back pain, does it help?
search_summary: Europe PMC: 3 searches, 34 new records screened, 5 suggested. Answer uses checked cards only. AI-checked, not clinician-reviewed.

suggestions.why: Network meta-analysis suggests pharmaceuticals often reduce pain better than non-pharmacological options in low back pain.

gaps: Discogenic-specific NSAID trials are scarce; most evidence comes from mixed chronic low back pain populations.
Head-to-head comparisons with other analgesics or exercise-based care are largely missing.
Follow-up is usually short, so durability of benefit and harms remain uncertain.
Evidence does not clearly separate discogenic pain from other low back pain phenotypes.
